meta.created_by: edna fable seat, S7 eval-cases-first pass
meta.purpose: Behavioral expectations for the S7 structured case record, authored BEFORE any runtime change. Every case is written against advisor-visible behavior only: ask-once across turns, ROP derivation from the existing-plans answer, cross-turn fact retention, corrections superseding earlier facts, clean case boundaries with no fact bleed, no dependence on a /new command, and drafts whose material facts all trace to something the advisor said. No case asserts on an internal structure; the record is judged only through what the advisor sees.
meta.id_range: MTU-044 .. MTU-055 (continues mtu-eval-corpus-v1.json, whose highest id is MTU-043; no other MTU-0xx ids exist in this repo)
meta.relation_to_corpus: Additive. mtu-eval-corpus-v1.json is untouched; overlapping tags (intake, rop, ask-once, new-case-boundary) mean a knowledge or constitution edit in those areas should run BOTH files.
meta.scoring_scope: Per the schema, expected[] is judged on the FINAL response and expected_before_next on the reply to its own turn. Several exact_absent checks here (superseded premiums, superseded plan names, prior-case facts) name values that legitimately appear in an EARLIER reply of the same case — they are absent-in-the-final-draft checks. A runner that concatenates all replies before a deterministic string check will report false failures on MTU-049, MTU-050, MTU-051, MTU-052 and MTU-053.
meta.vocabulary_note: Advisor-facing expectation strings use advisor vocabulary only (case, facts already given, fresh case, draft). Internal S7 terms are absent from every exact_* text and every label.
